WITH route AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-117.257147 45.396457, -117.258332 45.399858, -117.25911 45.401048, -117.259304 45.401779, -117.259401 45.401848, -117.259692 45.403357, -117.260598 45.405941, -117.261149 45.406719, -117.261636 45.407108, -117.262057 45.407245, -117.264749 45.407235, -117.265095 45.407335, -117.268781 45.409813, -117.269651 45.410158, -117.270686 45.410496, -117.271156 45.410602, -117.271646 45.410653, -117.276468 45.410699)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg
  FROM route r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.seg_len_m,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p1) AS z1,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p2) AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip dc
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM slopes
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DEGREES(ATAN(g)) AS slope_degrees
FROM avg_grade;
